summary: ESAB Corp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Eddyfi Holding Inc. for $1.45 billion in cash on June 1, 2026. The acquisition was financed with cash on hand, proceeds from a 5.625% senior notes offering, and private placements of Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock ($175M) and common stock ($143M), per the Share Purchase Agreement among the vendors, Holdcos, and ESAB. The filing also updates charter and equity sales. Watch for integration execution and the impact of the convertible preferred overhang.
